_comment: OPTIONAL, LOCAL. Copy to config/manager_canon.json (gitignored — it holds your leaguemates' real names). Maps an ESPN primary-owner GUID to the canonical manager name the analysis pipeline should use. You only need it to (a) collapse a manager who used more than one ESPN account across seasons into one identity, or (b) fix inconsistent scraped display names. Absent → analysis falls back to each team's scraped owner name (still works, just no cross-account merging). Find the GUIDs in scraping/raw/<season>/league_full.json under members[].id / teams[].owners[].
